title: Retaining the planned candidate archive removes the cross-package copy's second deflate, at the price of one whole serialized package held in the plan
decision: design, retained; no production code changed
code_state: documentation only on the branch; the measured implementation is a scratch patch retained in results/change-0646/patch/ and is not merged
reason_codes: queue item 8 of change 0630, left open by change 0598 with the words 'it changes the plan's memory profile under ADR 0005 and needs a frozen design record'; this is that record

the saving is real and exact on counts: bounded_package_bytes 2 -> 1 and PackageWriter::write_to_stream 7 -> 6 calls per lifecycle, with zlib_rs::deflate::deflate halved on both corpora and every other call count unchanged

the memory price is measured exactly rather than estimated: the plan's live bytes rise by the archive buffer plus the 40-byte Arc header and by nothing else, and return to parity when the plan is dropped
the design is frozen with a proof chain that keeps every apply-time verdict, and the one proof it replaces with an argument is re-derived by a debug assertion that the whole 871-test suite exercises

it is designed and not built because ADR 0005 requires a hierarchical budget this path does not have, and the implementable alternative (a sixth member of opened::Limits) is a breaking public API change

accepted_evidence.counts: callgrind isolation pairs at --samples 1 and 3, differenced over the two extra samples, per leg and selector; call counts per callee and inclusive Ir for the twelve symbols the record names
accepted_evidence.allocations: litchi-perf-baseline-alloc retention --api owned, 5 samples after 1 warmup per leg on both corpora, with the nine ownership checkpoints, the observer-ordered region peak and the absolute allocator counters
accepted_evidence.timing: tools/perf-baseline --warmup 3 --samples 30 over all four cross-copy selectors in one process, order A1 B1 B2 A2 on CPU 21, with the A/A and B/B floors from the repeated legs in the same window
accepted_evidence.native_cycles: perf stat -e cycles,instructions whole child, the same A1 B1 B2 A2 order at --warmup 1 --samples 10
accepted_evidence.value_identity: one output_sha256 per corpus across all four timing legs and all eight callgrind profiles, identical between the legs
accepted_evidence.verdicts_unchanged: cargo test -p litchi-pptx on the untouched before checkout (871 passed) and on the scratch tree (874 passed, the three added binding-proof tests), with the debug assertion re-serializing the candidate on every reuse

accepted_costs.plan_memory: the plan holds one whole serialized candidate archive for its lifetime; at the default limits the worst case per plan goes from max_patch_bytes (128 MiB) to twice that
accepted_costs.apply_copy: OpcPackage::from_vec takes an owned Vec, so the retained Arc is copied once per application; removing that needs a shared-bytes ingress in litchi-opc, which is an ADR 0011 question and is not taken
accepted_costs.region_peak: on the media-rich corpus the lifecycle's peak live bytes rise by about one archive; on the plain corpus they fall, because the removed writer's growth buffer is worth more than the retained 31 KB
accepted_costs.unproved_step: a fresh to_stream of the in-memory candidate is no longer compared against the retained bytes; its proof is the four staleness checks plus determinism, re-derived by a debug assertion
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind counts rep movsb per byte and runs SHA-256 in software; one deterministic run per leg

known_gaps.no_real_deck: the largest .pptx under test-data/ is 972,788 bytes, so no real fixture exercises the large end of the retention ceiling; the media-rich corpus is synthetic and deliberately incompressible
known_gaps.opt_in_shape: the scratch retains unconditionally to size the design; the policy the design specifies (Rebuild / RetainUpTo / Require) is not implemented or measured
known_gaps.scratch_provider: the ADR 0005 caller-supplied scratch route is specified as out of scope and is neither designed in detail nor measured
known_gaps.apply_patch: retention is specified for CrossSlideCopyPlan only; the durable CrossSlideCopyPatch carries no archive and apply_patch is unchanged and unmeasured
known_gaps.source_backed: no source-backed cross-copy selector exists, so SourceBackedCrossSlideCopyPlan is not measured

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, range-source, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
any statement about the shipped library: no production code changed
